descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
R Systems is looking for a talented and passionate Senior Software Engineer to join our growing team focused on software development.
 As Software Engineer in R Systems you will be a part of a team responsible for maintaining and development of complex platforms for networking company. You will have a chance to work with many different technologies in a team that is adapting the newest trends in software development.
 You will have a unique opportunity to learn in depth the telco industry.
 Here is what you will have to do: 
Participating in system integration and development projects
Supporting the existing team in maintaining complex platforms for telco operators, solving technical issues.
Communication with the customer technical team to facilitate solving issues.
Preparing project documentation.
 What you will need to succeed: 
Experience in software development in Java, Spring, Spring Boot
Experience with containerization in Docker.
Knowledge of Oracle, MySQL.
Knowledge and experience with telecommunication signaling protocols
Assertiveness, self-confidence, creativity, customer facing skills.
Very good communication skills.
Very good spoken and written English.
Readiness to take responsibility for the assigned tasks and ability to decompose bigger chunks of work.
